A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Monitored MBIE-EB research. The complete main texts and Appendices A–I are readable, and corresponding equations, experiments, figures, and tables can be matched despite relocation and editing.

before.justification: v2 reports original reinforcement-learning experiments, including the 48 benchmarks in Figure 6, Bottleneck evaluations, and ablations in Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v5 retains original benchmark experiments and appendix ablations, including revised learning curves in Figure 6.

M1.justification: The component-specific bonuses, pessimistic treatment of unobserved rewards, observe/optimize episode switching, and known-monitor adaptation remain unchanged. Equations (5)–(9) and Algorithm 1 retain the same procedure; revisions to theoretical parameter constants do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Both retain the 48 environment-monitor benchmarks and the Bottleneck scenarios covering solvable and unsolvable tasks, stochastic observability, and known monitors. No dataset, task, or environmental coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Directed-E2 remains the benchmark comparator, including its pessimistically initialized appendix comparisons. The optimistic and pessimistic MBIE-EB ablation comparators also remain in their corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Both retain discount factor 0.99, evaluation every 100 interaction steps using 100 test episodes, the same episode limits, and the retained experimental hyperparameter values. The corrected Full-Random hiding-probability prose matches the monitor formula already present in v2.

E4.justification: The pessimism and explore-to-observe ablations in Figures 12–13 are retained with unchanged plotted results. Appendix B also retains the observability sweeps, monitor-size comparisons, and known-monitor analyses; relocating their presentation adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Both report results over 30 seeds with 95% confidence intervals. No repeated-run count, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical testing procedure changes; revised Figure 6 confidence-band values are result changes.

E6.justification: Several Figure 6 curves and confidence bands change, notably showing slower Monitored MBIE-EB learning on River Swim with the Button monitor. Section 4.2 and the caption revise 44 wins and four ties against Directed-E2 to 43 wins and five ties. Other experimental figures retain their plotted results.

T1.justification: v5 applies unit reward bounds throughout the theoretical analysis and revises Theorem 3.1's reward factors and confidence constants. It refines Equation (2) and Definition H.1, corrects arithmetic in Lemma F.1, changes Lemma F.5's selected constant from 6 to 1/6, and changes the bandit discount factor from one to zero in Appendix I. These locally revise existing theory while retaining the main claimed inverse-observability rate.

C1.justification: Both claim a model-based Mon-MDP algorithm, empirical exploration advantages, and the first finite-sample minimax guarantee covering solvable and unsolvable cases. Removing 'Truthful' from the title does not remove the truthfulness assumption from the text.

C2.justification: The explanations of optimism, pessimism, reward-observation exploration, and known-monitor benefits remain substantively the same. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning separate objectives, explicit counts, large or continuous spaces, and the stopping decision.

D1.justification: The MBIE-EB hyperparameter table drops observe-phase fields, and v2's explanation for sharing the observation schedule across Appendix B.4 settings is removed. Learning-rate annealing is clarified but was already tabulated. Code access, hardware, runtime, and the principal implementation settings remain.

R1.justification: The bibliography retains the same works, but Section 2.2 reattributes asymptotic convergence from Parisi et al. (2024b) to (2024a). Figure 10 changes its statement about Directed-E2 from having a theoretical sample-complexity bound to never having one, aligning the caption with the introductory positioning.

P1.justification: The title and headers drop 'Truthful'; wording, grammar, terminology, and citation formatting are edited throughout. Several appendix passages are condensed, and the pseudocode and implementation appendices exchange order. The overall narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: Figures 12–13 are brought onto the same page, duplicate legends are removed, and captions are shortened. The hyperparameter tables become labeled panels of Table 1, with a shorter MBIE-EB panel. The figure inventory and experimental plot structure remain.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves mathematical precision and readability through explicit theoretical normalization, local corrections such as Lemma F.5's constant, and clearer organization of implementation information. Figure 6's summary reflects the reduced comparative advantage. The omitted scheduling explanation and unresolved proof inconsistencies limit these gains; the revision does not substantially strengthen the paper's overall evidential foundation.
